review_description: Hi Robert,As a valued past customer of Infinite Energy, I write to formally notify you of the company’s decision to cease selling solar rooftop and battery systems for both residential and commercial customers.This decision was a very difficult one but made necessary as a result of changing energy sector dynamics and Infinite Energy’s previous national expansion plans being negatively impacted by the onset of the pandemic.As you will be aware, Infinite Energy was focused on delivering only the highest quality rooftop solar and battery systems for both residential and commercial applications.While the WA solar market continues to add rooftop solar capacity, maintaining a business model that could support a quality product offering has become unsustainable for us. The highly saturated, low margin and low barrier-to-entry solar market in the State contributed to the company’s decision.We recognise that your decision to choose Infinite Energy was based on our quality product offering and customer service, so this announcement will no doubt be disappointing to you.All Infinite Energy customers have the benefit of both product and workmanship warranties in relation to their systems, and Infinite remains committed to ongoing customer support into the future. Any support calls can continue to be submitted through our Support Hero portal or phone 1300 074 669.I would like to take this opportunity to thank you for choosing an Infinite Energy system for your property.
Great service, knowledgeable salesman and first class info provided in timely manner. Very happy with all aspects of the purchase and installation.
Really excellent service from quotation, explanation, to installation. Everything was handled competently and punctually. Cost was competitive.

Sales process was generally good - nice range of options, clear quote, technical questions answered well, nice and responsive salesman A little negative points for a few later "scare" emails warning of dodgy  installers, price rises etc. that came across as insincere hard sell tactics that I would have preferred not to see. 4/5Installation booking time was medium compared with other people's - 3 weeks - but allowed me a change of date with no fuss. Meter replacement was quick, and all Western Power / Synergy paperwork done for me. 4.5/5Installation went flawlessly. Nice crew, bang on time, tidy job, neat and symmetrical panel arrangement and invisible cabling (not that it matters, but a quality job shows). 4 1/2 hr job, with half hour without power for hookup. Bit of noise as you'd expect, but generally zero hassles. 5/5Equipment seems good so far and easily achieving intended power output. Minor complaint that the iSolarcloud app looks like it provides house power measurement and net to/from grid draw, when it actually needs an additional smartmeter to do this, and I wasn't offered the option for the smartmeter in the quote process. Install is on West wall, and the inverter got extremely hot in the afternoon with the sun on it, but installer didn't offer a sunshield (though a $100 sheet of aluminium from Bunnings fixed that easily enough). 4/5Minor glitch in invoicing when phone system was down for a few days, but they still gave me the Day 1 payment discount anyway.

We chose Infinite Energy based on the sales experience - they provided three options and actually recommended not to go with the most expensive option based on our consumption. There was no constant phone calls or pressure. Booking the installation was a simple process. The sub-contracted installers (West State Electrical) turned up on time, were very polite and kept me informed. There were a couple of issues; the consumption meter appeared to be faulty (the installer stayed late to try and get it working) but on a return visit it seemed to have been installed incorrectly - so that was rectified. We also had a small leak in our roof (fortunately we had heavy rain a couple of days after the install and noticed the dripping noise) and they returned to rectify this within a couple of hours of me contacting them. They also followed up after the return visit to check I was satisfied that the issues had been resolved, which was a nice touch.

Having had a few "salesmen" call at home, Infinite Energy was a totally seamless process with everything handled over the phone and email.Polite, caring, ready to massage their plan to suit my needs.Installation done mid winter and having to work around heavy rain and/or drizzle on a 2 story home was tricky. The team was fantastic and worked to get the job done in complete safety. No mess.All connections carried out and also assisted to have the phone app installed.Could not be happier
Excellent, Chris Barnes true professional.Excellent, Service installers were communicative, thorough and tidyExcellent, Communication throughout the whole process was professional and informative

Angry to be recommended this company.If we knew they were closing down like so many other solar companies have we wouldn’t have gone with them.Now we will forever have worries if something goes wrong with our system where service we will get in terms of warranty.

Sales and quoting process professional and courteous. Enough options provided. Listened to needs and adapted.Installation from contracted labour. Professional. Quick to adapt to changing conditions (had to rearrange geometry of panels compared to initial plan).  Wrong brackets (colour only) were initially supplied, and no fuss to go get the correct ones. Worked out better than planned to fit roof shape and provide longer exposure to the sun.Worked first time, no cleanup or follow-up required.Connection and up and running with app and account within 48hrs.However, company has since stopped selling solar to residential and commercial customers due to financial reasons (mid-Feb 2022).  My install was Sep 2021 and at the time were close to top rated provider in WA.Very disappointing that even after a lot of research and going with top rated supplier. One can never know the true financial stability of these businesses.

The process was made very simple and painless. The Sales Person was friendly and punctual with answers to questions.Installed without a hitch. Polite installers who explained everything in simple terms.
Appreciated the personalised approach of Infinite Energy and their sales team. They recommended a system that met the unique challenges of our property.

From the get go I never felt pressured to make choice at the point of quoting. Even the follow up emails were polite and simply checking on where we were at in our decision making process.Justin came out to talk to me and explained everything really well.The Install team was fantastic. They were on time, respectful, polite and friendly. They were more than happy to accommodate my requests for information and at the end explained everything clearly and answered all my questions.Afterwards, I thought of a few questions and my emails were answered in good time with understandable explanations and answers.The system is working brilliantly, even on a couple of the overcast days we have had since.Whilst I am sure there are other companies who are of the same caliber, I can only speak to Infinite Energy as being a company to use seeing as this is who we went with.

Alex from Infinite Energy gave me honest advise and was happy to answer all my questions. The guys were on time, very polite and got down to work as soon as they arrived. They had to work on the roof in 35 degree heat and still remained cheerful, so hats off to the installation team.Infinite Energy arranged  for Western power to change the meter and also arranged everything with my energy supplier, so very happy with the service
Super simple process beginning to end. Knowledgeable sales staff. No hard sell. Super efficient installation.
Great salesperson, great installation team and great to deal with all round.
Professional courteous no fuss just got on with the job. And they were good with the dog.

The sales person was very informative and addressed my individual concerns. He knew his stuff and after the call wasn't pushy just followed up politely and left it up to me. The process from there has been smooth and the installation was hassle free. It is only 4 days in but it is wonderful to see our production and usage on the monitoring app so we can modify when we use all our electricity.

Firstly, the sales process was a little "over-enthusiastic" - basically daily follow ups with us to get us to sign the contract.  Almost to the point that I nearly told them I didn't want to deal with them any more.  Then once we signed - radio silence.  I had to contact them nearly 3 weeks late to get an update to be told the inverter was held up due to shipping delays out of China.  I could understand that but contact from Infinite Energy to tell us would have been appreciated.Installation was about 2 months after we signed the contract.  Installers were great, good communication, very polite and accommodating and installed quicker than i thought.System works great, app and portal are really useful.  Really happy with the system and would highly recommend.
Excellent sales staff, not pushy but very informative, installation went like clockwork, very polite and tidy, cleaned up immaculately and explained and connected everything after install.

Sales rep was professional, factual and was prepared to spend the time going through all my questions with no hard sell.Installation crew were equally professional and paid attention to detail to get it right.The only downside is a faulty Tesla Wall and I am having trouble getting a response from the Tesla Technician
Painless process end to end and a top quality installer.  Happy with the outcome now just waiting on some sunshine!

The sales and quoting processes were done in a very professional manner. The solar company was not pushy with me to accept the quote.Installation was smoothly done and in accordance with the plan.Great customer service. Everything was well explained and communicated to me.

"How was the sales/quoting process?"Great!"How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?"Great. Yes, yes and yes."How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install?"Great. Yes they did.The problem is that one year after installation, the inverter goes into the same alarm (ground insulation error) at the first touch of the sun on the solar panels, and doesn't come back on line until hours later, and sometimes not at all for the entire day. This only seems to happen when there is moisture in the air ie rain overnight or a heavy dew. Once the system had begun generating power during the day, it won't go into error again even if there is rain during the day.The system has been inspected twice since I reported the fault to Infinite Energy, first time 3-4 weeks after I'd reported it to them; the second time it took them two months to get an inspection crew out. Two weeks later and I haven't received any feedback at all from the company.

The Sales person was very friendly, communicated well via email (which is my preferred method of communication). He also matched a deal a different company was offering for a similar setup.The installer was very friendly and explained everything in a way I could understand. Workmanship was good.Customer service was great, I didn't have to do a thing after signing the contract except pay the bill. Turn around time was super quick too!
Great product and app support. Monitoring software has been so valuable. System also integrated into Home Assistant automation which was a great feature.

Infinite Energy were easy to work with,Install time from payment was about 2 weeks.Communication via email is very good, forms and documentation are streamline.Subcontractors did the job and were timely, Clean install, 3 guys. Good explanation and demonstrations after install.After install emails good from both Infinite and Sub.Happy with the experience.
Great service,price and communicationMade it easier to choose

The sales person came to our house to explain quote. Grid connection occurred at the same time as installation. The installers were professional, punctual, polite, and tidy. The installation looks good.There was a delay of a couple of days before app was available so we were unable to see our system working immediately.
Sales person o.kInstallation guys friendly and on time.

Infinite Energy was prompt, efficient and provided a high quality product that was properly installed. There were no high-pressure sales, came onsite to physically inspect for the quote, and made sure everything went smoothly.  The installation team were prompt, courteous and meticulous - they did a neat and fantastic job, made sure everything worked properly (including registration of analytics) and really cleaned up after themselves (they even blew off all the dust on my porch). They might be more expensive than some competitors, but I'm satisfied that I got what I paid for.

A neighbour of mine had Infinite Energy install their system and so I added them to my list of vendors. The team at Infinite Energy were excellent. The sales consultant was not pushy and always happy to help answering questions before I committed to the purchase having given me 6 different set-ups to chose from. Once I signed up the approval process went through very quickly from the energy retailer and our meter was changed out by our provider. The Infinite Energy scheduling team arranged a date for the install and everything was set. On the day of installation I asked if an extra component (a consumption meter) could be added to the system and this additional was handled by Infinite and the installation team from West State Electrics with no fuss or delay. The install was really smooth with minimal disruption and no mess left behind at the end.A great job done by all involved.

response to quote was timely and had someone onsite shortly after, kept me informed of installation date and no delays. Installation was very professional and the boys did a great job. Only criticism was the SMA Invertor doesn't have appropriate smart metre technology which I'm now resolving with a Solar Analytics metre to be installed. Unsure if this was my fault when purchasing system or got confused when talking with salesman.

Some sales guys were a bit pushy, quotes can be hard to compare as companies use different products.Installation was delayed due to supplies, then when actually installing roof pitch issues forced me to change inverters.  Actual installers, brilliant - is was 39 C and they worked all day to complete the fittings.Customer service from Company was brilliant, refunded the difference of inverters.

Great customer service. The process and details were explained properly, I had several questions (including basic - stupid ones) Jason at Infinite Energy was patient, polite, and answered all my queries until I was satisfied.Installation was seamless. Two technicians from Western Fusion showed up on time. They were polite and knew exactly what were they doing. Very professional...Overall satisfied.
Customer liaison was great and the installation was very quick. There was no mess left, either. Extra information for sitting panels was obtained to give an idea of  sun transit throughout the day.

Infinite energy were thorough with explaining many options available and knowledgeable regarding systems. Installation was well managed with personnel polite, punctual with good focus on a safe install. Would definitely recommend infinite energy.

I did quite a lot of research first, comparing prices, quality of products, and experience of companies involved. Finished up going with Infinite Energy, which was by no means the cheapest, but unlike several other quotes, the salesperson was pleasant, not pushy and laid out all the facts clearly. I finished up buying a mid to high-range product, mainly based on the experience and positive reviews of Infinite Energy. The whole process went very smoothly, from the quote to the refitting of the meter box, to the installation (20 panels fitted in about 5 hours), to the installers themselves who were very professional, polite and helpful. The system has been in operation now for about a month and appears to be working perfectly. I am looking forward to many years of saving and would thoroughly recommend this company to anybody else.

No hard sell.Face to face meeting couldn't go ahead with coronavirus; I requested skype or suchlike, but they couldn't organise that. We had an hour long phone call, but the quality was poor and he had to call back twice. This precluded a longer discussion.Which was a shame, because the other company met me for an hour and we had a great discussion. Unfortunately I didn't pick them, because their premium offering was too much, and their value offering was too little and low quality. (Solaire, (Premium: REC + SE ; Value SE (generic) + SE)The quotes were competitive, particularly with the value panel options.The consumption monitor / smart meter was thrown in free which was greatly appreciated and helped to swing my decision to choose IE.Follow up emails to salesperson were sometimes ignored or took a while to answer, though improved when I highlighted this.Cannot fault the installation process, which was through a subcontractor who was very professional.

This was my third quote and the sales person was very relaxed and friendly. We discussed what I had been offered by the other retailers and I got answers as to the factors differentiating this offer. Panel capacity 275Kw or 330Kw and layout requirements. Inverter type and panel/inverter combinations. I was not given an individual quote at this stage but left with a flyer with 3 panel/inverter setups priced to supply the requirements I had requested. I chose the mid priced system after further discussion with the technical expert in the house.Installation was punctual and the workmen were polite and mostly tidy. A few bits of stray cable and sheathing did not make it into the bin.The electrician ensured that the system was fully functional and registering on the (in house) monitoring system prior to leaving the property. I had a further query regarding the system later that week and my email was answered promptly. I was informed that the service department could take up to 3 days to answer my non urgent query. I was very happy when the information I had requested was sent to me early the next day.

The 2 installers were efficient they had the system up and running in less than 2 hours (20 panels) including running the control panel into the garage - unlike other service providers we have used for other work around the house they arrived on time and cleaned up after completing the job. They went through the operation of the new system and set it up so I could monitor the results on line before leaving - set up on the day with access approval sent a couple of days later. All in all very impressed with their work and how quickly they went from quote to installation - less than 4 weeks.

The salesperson was very professional and had a very strong understanding about the different systems currently on the market which helped greatly in making the decision of which system would best suit my needs.  The quote was sent when it was promised and was presented in a very professional manner.The installation went without a hitch.  The installers arrived a half earlier than expected, introduced themselves then proceeded with the installation.  They were very polite and tidy and more than happy to go through the system with any questions I had.Customer service did everything from beginning to end.  I could not be more happy with the level of service provided.

Infinite energy were very professional from the very first contact session. The quote was concise, several options were provided.Installation was conducted on the date planned and took the amount of time indicated on the contract, the install team were well presented. The installation is neat, they discussed the location of all components ahead of installation which was good.Would be happy to recommend infinite energy to others considering solar
One of Australia's most reputable solar company. Competitive prices. Half day to install the whole system!

The sales and quoting process was smooth and efficient and completed by phone over a two week period of genuine discussions and advice and followed up by appropriate email correspondence.  The tradesmen were on time, very efficient, and the installation completed on time and very professionally. Customer service was excellent with all external grid connections arranged by the solar installation company with timely advice provided to me.

I had signed up for Foxtel several weeks prior to installation of the panels. The next day, after installation I was unable to access Foxtel.  A technician was called in and after inspection  found the mounting of the dish had been inadvertently damaged and required repair. I rang the installation company to advise them of the situation and that I had been charged $100. After discussion they advised an invoice would be raised and I would be reimbursed. I understand connection by Western Power can take up to 30 working days and I am sure that will happen somewhere along the way.
battery_brand: no battery chosen at this time (Other)

review_description: Seamless installation, friendly installers, great job. Generation living up to expectations.

Very efficient and courteous process from Infinite Energy from initial email receipt of request for quote, arranging a suitable time for a consultant to visit, through to completion of installation.Both installation teams were efficient, polite and tidy. The installation could not be completed in one day due to circumstances.The SolarEdge option included consumption monitoring (no cost bonus at time of the quote) which I think is a good option for the householder to have - knowing how much energy is being consumed or exported/imported at any time.

We have a pool, plus a well and bore for garden water. Electrivity bills were always in excess of $400. It is a bit early to be precise but it looks like we will now pay about one third of what we did before. We use 240V timers to ensure pumps only run during the day when solar system output is high.We chose Infinite Energy on the recommendation of an aquantence. The process of arranging the installation was hassle free and the Installers did a good job. A new meter was required and a contractor to Western Power did that. We didn't have to arrange that.
Sales/quoting process, was very good. Installation, very polite, tidy and punctual, the customer service was very good, they organised everything for me.

I started, as many people no doubt do, with a request for quotes from this site. Infinite Energy were the first of three vendors to get in touch. The first sales consultant, Rory O'Brien, sent me satellite photos of my roof at different times of the year, highlighting a couple of shade issues, a design which mitigated the issue through placement of panels, and suggestions for system options which would further maximise production under those circumstances. After I agreed to remove a tree that caused the smaller of my shade issues (unfortunately, I can't remove my northern neighbour's multi-storey property), Rory revised the design accordingly.After discussions with two other vendors, I came back to Infinite Energy with more questions. Rory was on leave and Daniel Overd took over the sale. Daniel was incredibly responsive, answering a number of questions quickly, even after hours and on the weekend when I wasn't expecting to hear back until at least the following business day. Between Rory's initial, well-prepared approach, Daniel's excellent responsiveness and product knowledge, the premium quality options available, and ultimately a competitive price, I chose to go with Infinite Energy. The sales process was straightforward. I paid a deposit and Infinite Energy booked a date for installation and arranged the grid connection on my behalf.The installation itself was uneventful but had to be split over two days because of wet weather. The contractors who did the work were punctual, polite, tidy, and came across as experienced and knowledgeable. They also took precautions to make sure I wasn't left with a leaky roof due to having to abandon work on the first day because of coming storms.The post-sales support was excellent, with Daniel configuring my panel-level monitoring very quickly after the install, much sooner than the ETA I had been given.Ultimately, I'm very pleased with my system and can happily recommend Daniel, Rory, and the team at Infinite Energy.

Sales process was efficient for 2/3 companies - the other one didn't turn up.Installation and set up prior to installation was efficient and it all happened sooner than I expectedI'm enjoying the data generated.
Sales process was terrific!  Not installed yet!  There are a few hoaxes out there. Beware!!
Installation to be undertaken a the end of January or early Febuary

Everything was very simple and quick. No problems except that one of the 6 panel arrays would not fit on the north wall. Seems to be ok as is, and my average daily return in winter was 20kwh per day. Expect summer to be much higher.

Infinite Energy were not the cheapest quote we received.Their impressive client base, plus helpful knowledgeable people at all levels throughout the organisation were worth far more than any savings we would have made.
Young Lindsey was a pleasure to deal with.Approval in 4 days from the power company Unbelievable really.

Two very nice young men turned up on time and were very polite and helpful. The installation was done efficiently and everything was fully explained to us including assistance with downloading the monitoring app. Everything fully operational and tested prior to leaving. Would recommend them.
Sales process and installation very well performed. Sales person very knowledgeable.

Installers were excellent. Not only polite and effective, but highly knowledgeable, and walked us through all aspects of the installation and the system itself. The technical information we were given in deciding whether/what to buy was very clearly communicated, with no attempts to "upsell" us, but a genuine effort to ensure our needs were understood, and met in the most cost-effective way possible. We now have an operational system, working well, we enjoy monitoring it every day and watching the power happen! The only negatives I encountered were that it took a while before they could schedule the install, and then there was a weather delay that stopped it halfway, and it was another 2 weeks before they could come again. I guess this is a good thing, as they are very much in demand but it was a little frustrating for us. The company still managed the scheduling process professionally and always clearly communicated when to expect them, and they were always on time.
Quality people and product. Very happy. Rory was Knowledgeable, didnâ€™t push product and answered all my questions.

From the sales team to the installation guys it was a pleasure to go through Infinite Energy. The sales lady I dealt with was very helpful and polite when dealing with my numerous questions (most of which I got from the Solar Quotes website checklists)The installation team, West State Electrics, were very professional and helpful too - punctual and polite and got the job done quickly. Helped with the monitoring system and everything else to get it up and running.The information and set up details were all pretty good too - even Western Power came up with the goods by getting the meter box ready in plenty of time prior to installation.
They went the extra mile to avoid having to use any outside conduit for the awkward second storey, and managed to reorganise my meter box to avoid having an extra box for circuit breakers.

The installation staff were polite, respectful and punctual. The weather was not favorable for the installation of the panels on the first day.  Was good to see the staff operating in a safe manner and coming back another day to complete the installation.

Disappointed overall. Sales/quoting stage was OK but promises made at that stage were not followed through when it came to installation. Also, had problems with the system after installation. Diagnosed as a missing component but very poor response when it came to resolving this. It still has not been fixed months after the problem was identified.

The sales and quoting process was quick, responsive and informativeinstallation couldn't be faulted. Smooth, tidy and punctualthe grid connection has happened and the installer showed me how to access the reports from the inverter
The sales quote was easy to understand, with a business that has been operating for many years
Yes, just waiting on details to enable access to system performance ie the app

Good system for money, installers good guys but did break a lot of roof tiles, if you have tiled roof have over 20spares . Company should just have one person who deals with you as every time I received email or tried to contact them it was a different person.

I discovered in January (2020) of this year that Infinite Energy had deliberately not given me access to the sofware that monitors the performance of each panel. They did give me access once I specifically asked for it. I immediately discovered that one of my panels was showing zero output. It took them from early February to early June to finally install the misfunctioning part. The installers told me that was needed was for the new part to be registered in the system. That bit took nearly three weeks and I'm pretty sure it only happen after I emailed them and complained.

Sales.Knowledgeable, good advice, happy to answer multiple queries.Installation.On time, no fuss, no problem altering planned panel placement to fit roof infrastructure. Lead electrician had over 6 years solar installation experience, and was able to answer questions.

The quotation process was very professional, friendly and detailed. Rory at was always available to answer any queries I had during the assessment phase. The two installers Blake and Dylan were punctual, polite, engaging and respectful. While the office support staff were also helpful and friendly. The overall experience, from pre to post installation of our new solar panel system was excellent as the installation and connection went according to plan. I would have no hesitation in recommending Infinite Energy to anyone looking to install a solar panel system to their home.
Good installers, system working well but early to tell at this stage

Infinite Energy were very quick and efficient on their quoting and extremely helpful in assisting and advising throughout the process.  Installation was also well organised and professionally carried out.  Excellent service all round. They were more expensive than the other quotes but I felt more confident with them.
From  beginning to end every person I dealt with was informative and helpful.
Well done polite and good communication, very experienced and punctual.
Good information provided by sales team. Very quick installation timeframe. Quality components. Cheap price.

Sales rep knew his stuff and was not pushy to get an instant order.Process of getting new electricity meter was organised by Infinite Energy with no issues. Installation was carried out professionally and quality was good what I expected being an experienced Construction Manager. Installation crew were polite and kept us informed of progress. All in all a pretty seamless experience. Just got to see if the system performs as per spefications

Our property is shaded by a giant ghost gum which we were  reluctant to remove (in truth the sole reason that took us so long to get on board with solar.)  Infinite Energy offered up the best combination of inverter and panels to give maximum daily production within our budget. The installation team was fantastic and very knowledgeable.  So far the system seems to be matching their predictions for energy production.
I received good advice, from this company, not just trying to upsell.

Everything handled professionally and in agreed timeframe. They took the time for a personal meeting with engineer to answer my technical questions. Also had a show room where one could see panels, inverters and batteries.Installation was done well and system is working brilliantly.

Sales and qouting were very friendly, without being pushy. Answered my battery of questions in a cordial and accurate manner. The installers were fantastic, and showed me the before and after job. Because my roof was complicated, I have two inverters. I am happy with the job that was done.
It was a very stress free procedure. From getting the quotes, to negotiating the price and getting the system installed it was trouble free.
After sales service is weak as Iâ€™ve had to contact company to find out when system installed.

I was connected to Infinite Energy via the Solar Quotes website, unfortunately only one provider showed interest in providing a quote, fortunately I got Lindsey from Infinite Energy!Everything was so easy. I explained to Lindsey that telephone contact was difficult as I work full time, no problem - we did everything via email. Imagine my surprise to receive emails as late as 9pm and on weekends!! Every question was answered quickly. I felt no pressure to purchase and no pressure to go with the most expensive option - in the end I chose a mid range system that fit my budget and my needs.As to installation, I was able to arrange a day that worked within my work schedule. The installers (a team of two) arrived on time, and the installation was completed with minimal fuss. On arrival they determined my roof space was tighter than expected so I ended up with 17 panels instead of 18, which is still fine for my usage needs, and most days I generate more than I use.The estimated time to install was spot on accurate. I was shown how the system works and given some basic instructions. I was later emailed access to online monitoring of the system (it's pretty cool to be able to see how much power the system generates).Payment was easy, with options to bank transfer, or pay via credit card (1% surcharge and 2% for AMEX).Overall I'm really happy with the experience!
The sales person was knowledgeable and the products had good track record, seeing that they'd been used in the largest solar farms around Australia and Ikea. So we went with the larger company.
It was a very easy process from start to finish. Installation went well, and I was happy with the quality of the work (and I'm pretty fussy).Would recommend.

I engaged around 6 different companies for a Solar System, of the 6 companies I found Infinite Energy the easiest to deal with. Lindsey and the team were quick to respond to emails and to get tailored quotes back to me the same day.The quote that came back wasn't the cheapest, however through research I found it is best to avoid the ridiculously cheap systems and to rely more on the company's reputation. In saying that, the quote did come back competitive.The installers on the day did a good job, I was told they would be on site at 7 and they arrived right on time. They got to work quickly and had everything installed, set up and cleaned up early afternoon. The workmanship is good and I have no doubt the system will last 20 + years.I also like their referral system for anyone you put on to them, you will get $100 and the person they sign up receives a further $100 discount.
Infinite energy and Lindsey Ditfort made the whole process very simple. Here follow up is excellent

From start to finish Infinite Energy gave us a top class service.Daniel Overd the sales consultant ensured that we understood the product on offer and were happy before committing to the order.The install team were first rate very professional and very tiding, there was no damage or mess left behind, in all a top rate job highly recommendable*****

I had 3 installers ring to give me quotes and of the 3 only 1 put me onto the fact that here in Wa you cannot go bigger that a 5kw inverter if you wish to receive the feedin tariff. Needless to say that one installer was the one that got our business.

It is not worth it to take the cheapest option of which there were plenty when we put up solar. A bit more for proven longevity and performance cannot be iterated enough. The team at Infinite Energy sold us a high quality system, under predicted its actual performance which will lead to us paying it off in under 5 years. Daniel ensured the process from end-to-end was seamless and the installers responded well when challenged.

Daniel rang from Infinite Energy to give a quote but I had already received 3 quotes from other companies and told him I had decided to go with one of those, though nothing had been signed. I didnâ€™t want to waste his time and so told him not to bother. Daniel asked me about the system I had chosen and he advised the importance of good quality panels, with a quality Inverter and quality installation. Plus his advice was to chose  a company that can be relied upon to be there for the duration of the warranties (at least) with a good record of customer service. He sent me a quote with a photo of my roof showing where the panels would be placed. His price was one of the highest Iâ€™d received. I contacted the other company I had chosen and asked them to quote me on the same panels and Inverter as Infinite Energy and guess what....Iâ€™m still waiting! Not a peep back from them which is a good indicator of their customer service down the track. Anyway, after further discussions with Daniel and getting a discount for being an RAC member I signed up. I am so glad I did for peace of mind knowing I have an excellent system from a company that can be relied upon. The installation went ahead without a hitch, the installers were polite and professional. They were tidy and left no mess when they finished they and connected me to the grid straight away.
